subject: Inconsistent error in a simple model with an ordered variable

messages.author: fe85b9636ef30d7c
messages.subject: Inconsistent error in a simple model with an ordered variable
parts:
Dear Yves & lavaan community,

I get an error message when I try to fit a simple model that involves three exogenous numerical variables, one endogenous numerical variable, and one endogenous binomial variable. However, when I fit each equation independently, the models run just fine. I am using the development version (0.5-11). I have attached a snippet of data to illustrate the problem. I would like to know why the complete model won't run while the others do.

#First, I set the variables to be numeric or ordered (for a binary variable)
data$beh.binom<-ordered(data$beh.binom)
data$att<-as.numeric(data$att)
data$norm<-as.numeric(data$norm)
data$pbc<-as.numeric(data$pbc)

#A model that includes two equations fails to run
model1<-"
#Correlations
beh.binom~i.mean+pbc
i.mean~att+norm+pbc
"
fit1<-sem(model1,data=data,estimator="WLSMV",ordered="beh.binom")

#Error message:
Error in if (all(lik > 0)) logl <- sum(log(lik)) else logl <- -Inf : 
  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
In addition: Warning message:
In atanh(rho.init) : NaNs produced

#But, a model that uses only one of the equations works just fine
model2<-"
#Correlations
beh.binom~i.mean+pbc
"
fit2<-sem(model2,data=data,estimator="WLSMV",ordered="beh.binom")

#A model that uses the other equation only also works fine
model3<-"
#Correlations
i.mean~att+norm+pbc
"
fit3<-sem(model3,data=data,estimator="WLSMV")


Thanks,
Leighton

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Inconsistent error in a simple model with an ordered variable
parts:
On 03/05/2013 08:14 PM, Leighton Reid wrote:

> In atanh(rho.init) : NaNs produced

This is the culprit. In some (extreme) cases, the starting value for a
polyserial correlation is outside the [-1,1] range. This has been fixed
in the development version (0.5-12), which you can install by typing in R:

install.packages("lavaan", repos="http://www.da.ugent.be", type="source")

Could you try with this version? If you have any further issues, let me
know.

Yves.

Cheers,
Leighton
